status_code_data.description: The HTTP 303 See Other redirection response status code indicates that the browser should redirect to the URL in the Location header instead of rendering the requested resource.

meme_data.description: Distracted Boyfriend, also known as Man Looking at Other Woman, is a captioned stock photo series in which a man looks at the backside of a woman walking by while another woman, presumably his romantic partner, looks on disapprovingly.
